decisions.reason: As the flagship product closely aligned with existing agricultural crates and the firm's design capabilities, absorptive capacity is high and early market presence supports keeping it.
Foldable large containers build directly on the firm's container expertise and have dedicated website promotion, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve them.
Stackable crates are core to the firm's existing packaging knowledge, though the product line faces competitive pressure, the firm can likely learn and adapt.
Rackable pallets are an extension of the firm's pallet knowledge and manufacturing, allowing effective absorption of market results.
Spill-retention pallets require some additional environmental/safety knowledge, but the firm's pallet expertise and cooperation options support learning and retention.
Plastic pallets with load retainers are close to existing pallet offerings and have dedicated promotion, indicating commitment and high absorptive capacity.
